title: Staff Backend Engineer
description: <p>📍London / UK Remote | 💰 <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-0.pdf">Staff Backend Engineer (L60)</a> £130,000 - £170,000 + Equity&nbsp;+ <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>&nbsp;|&nbsp;<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a>&nbsp;- Engineering&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About our Engineering Teams:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We contribute to </span><a href="https://github.com/monzo"><strong>open source software</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> as much as possible. Our </span><a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"><strong>blog</strong></a><strong> </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">is a good place to learn even more about what we do!</span></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial </span><a href="https://tour.golang.org/welcome/1"><strong>here</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="http://cassandra.apache.org/"><strong>Cassandra</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for most persistent data storage</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="http://kafka.apache.org/"><strong>Kafka</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for our asynchronous message queue</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://www.envoyproxy.io/"><strong>Envoy Proxy</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for RPC</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="http://kubernetes.io/"><strong>Kubernetes</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and </span><a href="https://www.docker.com/"><strong>Docker</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to schedule and run our services&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="http://aws.amazon.com/"><strong>AWS</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for most of our infrastructure</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://facebook.github.io/react/"><strong>React</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for internal web dashboards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">We also have two physical datacenter sites with actual cables to connect to various third parties</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Your day-to-day&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This role is all about collaborating across disciplines to test hypotheses and make a difference to customers. As a product backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more!&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security &amp; Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.</span></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations &amp; Flexible Working:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.&nbsp;</p> <p>We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches &amp; treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.&nbsp;</p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're on the look out for L60 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our<a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">&nbsp;Engineering Progression Framework</a> we are also hiring on L40 &amp; L50, our interview process will determine your levelling.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our interview process involves three main stages:&nbsp;</span></p> <ol> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Initial Call&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take home task or pair coding exercise&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview&nbsp;</span></li> </ol> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">One of our engineers has
